mapper.select: SELECT id,tenant_id,device_sn,source_system,source_key,contract_no,package_no,shipment_time,product_code FROM ( SELECT s.id,s.tenant_id,s.device_sn,s.source_system,s.source_key,s.contract_no,s.package_no,s.shipment_time,s.product_code, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY s.device_sn ORDER BY s.shipment_time DESC,s.id DESC) AS latest_rank, MAX(CASE WHEN s.source_system='DPPMS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER(PARTITION BY s.device_sn ORDER BY s.shipment_time DESC,s.id DESC ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS has_dppms FROM ast_device_shipment s WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND s.deleted=FALSE ) ranked WHERE latest_rank=1 AND has_dppms=1 ORDER BY device_sn LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT product_code,product_model,product_name FROM ast_product_official_info WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND deleted=FALSE

SELECT d.id,d.tenant_id,d.version,d.shipment_record_id,d.project_assignment_version,d.customer_assignment_version,d.project_id,d.company_id,d.company_name,d.department_id,d.department_code,d.department_name,d.organization_source,d.organization_updated_at,d.sn,d.name,d.product_name,d.product_model,d.product_code,d.package_no,d.contract_no,d.status,d.source_system,d.source_key,d.source_version,d.sync_status,d.remark,d.creator,d.updater,d.shipment_time,d.synced_at,d.create_time,d.update_time,d.deleted,requests.requested_sn FROM ast_device d JOIN (
VALUES ROW(#{sn})
SELECT '' AS requested_sn WHERE 1=0
) requests(requested_sn) ON d.sn=requests.requested_sn COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci WHERE d.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ast_device d JOIN ( VALUES ROW(#{row.target.id},#{row.target.tenantId},#{row.target.version},#{row.target.projectAssignmentVersion},#{row.target.companyId},#{row.target.companyName},#{row.target.departmentId},#{row.target.departmentCode},#{row.target.departmentName}) ) incoming(id,tenant_id,version,project_assignment_version,company_id,company_name,department_id,department_code,department_name) ON incoming.id=d.id AND incoming.tenant_id=d.tenant_id SET d.company_id=incoming.company_id,d.company_name=incoming.company_name, d.department_id=incoming.department_id,d.department_code=incoming.department_code,d.department_name=incoming.department_name, d.organization_source='CONTRACT',d.organization_updated_at=#{context.startedAt},d.update_time=d.update_time WHERE d.tenant_id=#{context.tenantId} AND d.deleted=FALSE AND d.source_system='DPPMS' AND d.project_id IS NULL AND d.version=incoming.version AND d.project_assignment_version=incoming.project_assignment_version
